title: Dispatch on Type and Value
prompt: Implement `kindName<T>()` returning "int", "double", "string", or "other" via traits; and `pickN<K>(a, b)` where `K` is a `std::size_t` NTTP returning the K-th argument (K beyond 1 wraps).

tests.name: kindName classifies by traits
tests.hint: if constexpr (std::is_integral_v<T>) return "int"; else if constexpr (std::is_floating_point_v<T>) ... else if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, std::string>) ... else "other".

tests.name: pickN wraps by NTTP
tests.hint: return K % 2 == 0 ? a : b; — the NTTP is part of the type, so each K is a distinct instantiation.
